title: Savory Cheese Pull-Apart Bread
description: A German-inspired cheese bread filled with gooey cheese and a hint of arabian spice, perfect for a snack or dinner.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the beer, gooey cheese, flour, arabian spice, salt, and sugar. Mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes elastic and smooth.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour, or until it has doubled in size.
Punch down the dough and roll it out into a large rectangle.
Cut the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Place the balls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving about 1 inch of space between each ball.
Bake the bread for 15-20 minutes, or until it is golden brown.
Remove the bread from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
